I have a new idea for Recon's AI. We have the representation of order, but we
do not have the representation of repetition. So when generating ten images
based on a given definition, I think we are lacking a node attribute for how
many times to repeat the action.

The node attribute name and the node attribute value are separate things, and
we also need a node attribute type and a node attribute count.
